column1: # Postgres 16's built-in functions (pg_catalog's pg_proc), one a line, in COPY's text format (\N is null; \t, \n
# and \\ are escaped): oid, name (quoted where Postgres quotes it), argument types as regprocedure shows them,
# then prokind, prorettype, proretset, provolatile, proisstrict, prosecdef, proleakproof, proparallel,
# pronargdefaults, provariadic, prolang, procost, prorows, prosupport, proargtypes, proallargtypes, proargmodes,
# proargnames, prosrc, probin, proacl, pg_get_function_identity_arguments (\N: the argument types, with ", "
# between), pg_get_function_arguments (\N: the identity arguments), pg_get_function_result, and the SQL body
# pg_get_functiondef writes for a function with one (RETURN ...). pronamespace is 11, proowner 10.
# Made from a real Postgres 16.13/16.14 (the oids past 10000, which initdb gives, are 16.13's) by:
#   copy (with f as (select p.*, quote_ident(p.proname) q, substr(p.oid::regprocedure::text, length(quote_ident(p.proname)) + 1) a from pg_proc p where pronamespace = 11)

#   select oid, q, a, prokind, prorettype::int, proretset, provolatile, proisstrict, prosecdef, proleakproof, proparallel, pronargdefaults, provariadic::int, prolang::int, procost, prorows, prosupport::oid::int, proargtypes, proallargtypes, proargmodes, proargnames, prosrc, probin, proacl,
#   case when prosqlbody is not null then substring(pg_get_functiondef(oid) from E'\\n((RETURN|BEGIN ATOMIC)[\\s\\S]*)\\n$') end
#   from f order by oid) to stdout

BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT tt.alias,
     tt.description,
     parse.token,
     ARRAY( SELECT (m.mapdict)::regdictionary AS mapdict
            FROM pg_ts_config_map m
           WHERE ((m.mapcfg = (ts_debug.config)::oid) AND (m.maptokentype = parse.tokid))
           ORDER BY m.mapseqno) AS dictionaries,
     ( SELECT (m.mapdict)::regdictionary AS mapdict
            FROM pg_ts_config_map m
           WHERE ((m.mapcfg = (ts_debug.config)::oid) AND (m.maptokentype = parse.tokid))
           ORDER BY (ts_lexize((m.mapdict)::regdictionary, parse.token) IS NULL), m.mapseqno
          LIMIT 1) AS dictionary,
     ( SELECT ts_lexize((m.mapdict)::regdictionary, parse.token) AS ts_lexize
            FROM pg_ts_config_map m
           WHERE ((m.mapcfg = (ts_debug.config)::oid) AND (m.maptokentype = parse.tokid))
           ORDER BY (ts_lexize((m.mapdict)::regdictionary, parse.token) IS NULL), m.mapseqno
          LIMIT 1) AS lexemes
    FROM ts_parse(( SELECT pg_ts_config.cfgparser
            FROM pg_ts_config
           WHERE (pg_ts_config.oid = (ts_debug.config)::oid)), ts_debug.document) parse(tokid, token),
     ts_token_type(( SELECT pg_ts_config.cfgparser
            FROM pg_ts_config
           WHERE (pg_ts_config.oid = (ts_debug.config)::oid))) tt(tokid, alias, description)
   WHERE (tt.tokid = parse.tokid);
END
